name: smwgraphics-kirby-s-dream-land-3-iceberg
title: Kirby's Dream Land 3 - Iceberg 1
description:
A nice looking snowy mountain BG from Kirby's Dream Land 3. I've edited it a little to make it fill up the screen. Uses palette 3 and 7.
Vertical scroll must be set to none.
Credit would be really appreciated, but not needed I guess. Have fun!
